extension.description: A multi-repository Git client in the style of the JetBrains (WebStorm) Git Log: one merged log across every repository in your workspace, with branches, commit details, changed files and native diffs, and fetch, pull, checkout, merge and rebase across repositories.

setting.linyra.pageSize.description: Commits fetched per repository per page.
setting.linyra.maxConcurrency.descriptio: Maximum number of git processes running at once.
setting.linyra.scanDepth.markdownDescrip: Folder levels to search the workspace folders for repositories. Linyra shows these together with the repositories the Git extension has open. See also `#git.repositoryScanMaxDepth#`.
setting.linyra.excludeRepos.description: Glob patterns for repositories to leave out, matched against the repository folder name and its full path.
setting.linyra.profiles.markdownDescript: Named groups of repositories for the Repo List, e.g. `{ "backend": ["acme-api", "acme-libs"] }`. Each repository is its path relative to the workspace folder (`.` for the folder itself; in a multi-root workspace, the folder's name first). Saved from the Repo List; clicking a profile ticks its repositories and changes no other filter.
setting.linyra.blame.markdownDescription: Show who last changed the cursor's line in Linyra's diffs and revisions, as of the commit shown. The text follows `#git.blame.editorDecoration.template#`.
